about.p2: Macro photography rewards patience more than luck: hovering still enough, long enough, for a shrimp to go back to work or a frogfish to forget you exist. That's the part I love — the ocean carries on like you're not there, and every so often it lets you keep a frame of it.
about.p3a: Everything on this site was shot by me, on dives I logged. If you want to know the story behind a photo — or the dive site —
gal.lede: Three seasons of macro diving — frogfish, nudibranchs, pygmy seahorses, and the rest of the small universe. Click any photo to view it full screen; new work lands after every trip.
